## What's Changed
* ci: test against latest OpenCode on push/PR and a weekly schedule by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/22
* ci: drive OpenCode's real bash dispatcher, not only self-called hooks by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/23
* chore: delete dead leftovers after TUI diagnostics rewrite by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/25
* fix: record Ask-allow as Ask instead of GenericWrapper by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/26
* fix: keep /hypa last rewrite after tool.execute.after by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/24
* docs: fix plugin tuple example and split-entry spec by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/27
* chore: drop leftover @opentui direct deps after JSX-free TUI by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/28
* chore: trim real-shell smoke to /shell canary and dummy rewrite by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/29
* test: lock hypa resolve order and skip a repeat Windows native miss by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/30
* chore: wire Cloud Agent house-git identity by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/31
* chore: trim narrating comments and unused server type re-exports by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/32
* chore: pin @types/node to 24.13.3 by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/33
* chore: share one config field resolver by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/34
* chore: collapse duplicate PATH candidate checks by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/35
* chore: share one annotation prepend helper by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/36
* chore: derive option and source types from HypaConfig by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/37
* chore: share package-relative hypa binary lookup by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/38
* ci: add weekly Dependabot for npm and GitHub Actions by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/39
* release: bump to 1.0.4 by @kipyin in https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/pull/40


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kipyin/opencode-hypa/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4

## Fixed

- Ship a JSX-free `exports["./tui"]` as `dist/tui.js`. OpenCode skips JSX transform under `node_modules`, so the previous `dist/tui.jsx` failed to import and `/hypa` never registered.

Upgrade: `opencode plugin opencode-hypa@1.0.3 -g -f`

## Fixed

- Add `/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */` to the TUI entry so preserved JSX resolves under OpenCode/Bun.

Also includes 1.0.1: separate `./server` and `./tui` package exports so `/hypa` can register.

Upgrade: `opencode plugin opencode-hypa@1.0.2 -g -f`

## Fixed

- Split server and TUI into separate package entrypoints (`exports["./server"]`, `exports["./tui"]`) so OpenCode's TUI loader can register `/hypa`.
- Stop importing a non-existent `tui.js` while the build emits `tui.jsx`.

Upgrade: `opencode plugin opencode-hypa@1.0.1 -g -f`

## What's new

First stable release of the OpenCode Hypa hardwire.

### Added

- OpenCode server plugin that rewrites `bash` / `shell` tool calls through `hypa rewrite --json`.
- OpenCode-native configuration via `PluginOptions` and `OPENCODE_HYPA_*` environment variables.
- `/hypa` TUI diagnostics command showing resolved binary, Hypa version, effective config, and last rewrite.
- Tool-result annotation when Hypa rewrites a command so the LLM sees the original input.
- Fail-open behavior on rewrite errors and timeouts; deny/ask policies for Hypa outcomes.

Parity bar vs `@hypabolic/pi-hypa` delivered in #21.
